data.name: Flavienne
data.gender_notes: Flavienne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman family name 'Flavius', which means golden or yellow. In Christianity, several saints have this name. For example, Saint Flavian of Constantinople and Saint Flavian of Byzantium. The name Flavienne carries the meaning “Golden, Yellow, Flavored” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Flavienne usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, yellow, flavored and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion, loyalty, and a golden heart.
data.etymology: Flavienne belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden, Yellow, Flavored.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Flavienne total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
